sources.institution: Swiss Federal Statistical Office (Office fédéral de la statistique, BFS/OFS)
sources.title: Population résidante permanente et non permanente selon Année, Canton et Type de population
used_for: Population weights for the 26 Swiss cantons, used to compute a single population-weighted Swiss reference case (Switzerland has no single national withholding-tax schedule)

notes: This module reuses each country's own reference dataset (France: Mon-entreprise/Publicodes engine; Germany: analysis/germany; Belgium: analysis/belgium; Switzerland: analysis/switzerland) and does not redefine any country-level parameter.
See docs/data/comparison/comparison_parameters_2026.json for the harmonized wage grid, the exact PPP values used, the reference profile chosen per country, and the Swiss canton population figures.

France's personal income tax (prélèvement à la source) is not modeled in this comparison for the same reason it is not modeled in the France module itself: its rate depends on the household's personal tax situation and cannot be derived from a generic wage-only simulation. Germany, Belgium and Switzerland's income-tax withholdings are computed directly from the wage and are included.
